progressSections.taskDescription:
Set Task Resource. Add documents to Attachments. Use Checklist to review for complete submission. Prepare Fee Slip and send to applicant. 

Once paid, confirm Checklist complete.

If there is an Outstanding Fee Balance, the task will show as an error. 

If CANCELLED, the folder is set as Cancelled. 

When COMPLETE, the folder is set as Active.

Once complete, go to next task (Planner Review) add Task Resource (Specific Planner) and drop down to IN PROGRESS. This will send a referral to the Planner for review. Ensure that the Planner assigned is also set as the Folder Manager.

When IN PROGRESS, email will be to the Task Resource.

The City is considering a Development Permit with Variance application to add an extra storey and increase the number of residential units (14 new units for a total of 119) on a previously approved rental building while retaining the façade of the Heritage Designated building located at 827 Fort Street.

APPROVED BY COUNCIL NOVEMBER 23, 2023
The City is considering a Delegated Development Permit application to add another storey, increase number of units.

APPLICATION RETIRED: X-REF DPV#00169

The City is considering a Development Variance Permit application to make changes to the previously-approved plans with a parking variance.

APPROVED BY COUNCIL JUNE 24, 2021.

The City is considering a Development Permit with Variance application to make changes to the previously-approved plans with a parking variance.

APPROVED BY COUNCIL SEPTEMBER 5, 2019.

The City is considering a Heritage Alteration Permit with Variance application in conjunction with a Rezoning application for this property for the following:  retention and rehabilitation of the front façades at 819-823 Fort Street and 825 Fort Street, as well as the exterior design, finishes and landscaping of a new ten-storey, mixed-use building.

The Zoning Regulation Bylaw for RMD-2, Residential Mixed Use Fort Street District, is varied or supplemented as follows:
•  increase the maximum height from 30m to 31.1m
•  increase the maximum projection into height for rooftop structures from 5.0m to 5.1m for the elevator overrun
•  reduce the minimum short term bicycle parking from 12 stalls to 0 stalls
•  reduce the minimum vehicle parking from 76 stalls to 57 stalls.

APPROVED BY COUNCIL SEPTEMBER 5, 2019.

The City is considering a Rezoning Application to increase the density and construct a ten-storey, mixed-use building with ground-floor commercial uses and rental residential apartments above. The proposal would retain the façade of the Heritage Designated building located at 825 Fort Street and designate the façade of 819 Fort Street.
The City is considering a Development Permit with Variance application.

The City is considering a Rezoning application to repeal the CD-19 Zone, Douglas Caledonia Comprehensive Development District, and replace it with a new zone that will be substantively the same as the existing zone but without a bonus density or community amenities section, consistent with the recently enacted changes to the Local Government Act. A concurrent Development Permit with Variances application relates to form and character changes to a previously approved proposal,which includes three distinct buildings over a shared commercial podium that includes office, a full-service grocery store, childcare and a large public urban plaza. Additional variances from the Council approved proposal relate to height and parking.

Concurrent with DPV No. 00262.

APPROVED BY COUNCIL July 31, 2025

SEE CONCURRENT REZONING APPLICATION REZ00883 FOR PROJECT DETAILS.

The City is considering a Development Permit with Variances application to allow for form and character changes to a previously approved proposal,which includes three distinct buildings over a shared commercial podium that includes office, a full-service grocery store, childcare and a large public urban plaza. Additional variances from the Council approved proposal relate to height and parking.

APPROVED BY COUNCIL July 31, 2025

Approved by Council November 16, 2023

The City is considering a Rezoning application to increase the density and construct three residential towers ranging in heights from 16 to 21 storeys over a shared commercial podium, including a large public plaza.

Concurrent with Development Permit with Variance No. 00205

Approved by Council November 16, 2023

Concurrent with Rezoning Application REZ00815

The City is considering a Development Permit with Variance application to develop three distinct buildings over a shared commercial podium that includes office, a full-service grocery store, childcare and a large public urban plaza. Variance for height and parking.

Council approved variances:
•	increase the maximum building height of Building A from 45m to 55m
•	increase the maximum building height of Building B from 45m to 72m
•	increase the maximum building height of Building C from 45m to 65m
•	reduce the minimum setback for a rooftop structure from the outer edge of a roof from 3m to 0m for Building B
•	increase the maximum coverage for rooftop structures from 20% to 50%
•	reduce the required number of residential parking spaces from 297 to 226
•	reduce the required number of visitor parking spaces from 45 to 30.
This application was changed to DPV00205

permits.purpose: Approved by Council November 16, 2023 Concurrent with Rezoning Application REZ00815 The City is considering a Development Permit with Variance application to develop three distinct buildings over a shared commercial podium that includes office, a full-service grocery store, childcare and a large public urban plaza. Variance for height and parking. Council approved variances: • increase the maximum building height of Building A from 45m to 55m • increase the maximum building height of Building B from 45m to 72m • increase the maximum building height of Building C from 45m to 65m • reduce the minimum setback for a rooftop structure from the outer edge of a roof from 3m to 0m for Building B • increase the maximum coverage for rooftop structures from 20% to 50% • reduce the required number of residential parking spaces from 297 to 226 • reduce the required number of visitor parking spaces from 45 to 30.

A concurrent Development Permit with Variances application relates to form and character changes to a previously approved proposal,which includes three distinct buildings over a shared commercial podium that includes office, a full-service grocery store, childcare and a large public urban plaza. Concurrent with Development Permit with Variance No. 00205

Approved by Council November 16, 2023

Concurrent with Rezoning Application REZ00815

The City is considering a Development Permit with Variance application to develop three distinct buildings over a shared commercial podium that includes office, a full-service grocery store, childcare and a large public urban plaza. Variance for height and parking.

Council approved variances:
•	increase the maximum building height of Building A from 45m to 55m
•	increase the maximum building height of Building B from 45m to 72m
•	increase the maximum building height of Building C from 45m to 65m
•	reduce the minimum setback for a rooftop structure from the outer edge of a roof from 3m to 0m for Building B
•	increase the maximum coverage for rooftop structures from 20% to 50%
•	reduce the required number of residential parking spaces from 297 to 226
•	reduce the required number of visitor parking spaces from 45 to 30.
This application was changed to DPV00205

relatedPermits.relatedPermitDescription:
The City is considering a Rezoning application to repeal the CD-19 Zone, Douglas Caledonia Comprehensive Development District, and replace it with a new zone that will be substantively the same as the existing zone but without a bonus density or community amenities section, consistent with the recently enacted changes to the Local Government Act. A concurrent Development Permit with Variances application relates to form and character changes to a previously approved proposal,which includes three distinct buildings over a shared commercial podium that includes office, a full-service grocery store, childcare and a large public urban plaza. Additional variances from the Council approved proposal relate to height and parking.

Concurrent with DPV No. 00262.

APPROVED BY COUNCIL July 31, 2025

SEE CONCURRENT REZONING APPLICATION REZ00883 FOR PROJECT DETAILS.

The City is considering a Development Permit with Variances application to allow for form and character changes to a previously approved proposal,which includes three distinct buildings over a shared commercial podium that includes office, a full-service grocery store, childcare and a large public urban plaza. Additional variances from the Council approved proposal relate to height and parking.

APPROVED BY COUNCIL July 31, 2025

Approved by Council November 16, 2023

Concurrent with Rezoning Application REZ00815

The City is considering a Development Permit with Variance application to develop three distinct buildings over a shared commercial podium that includes office, a full-service grocery store, childcare and a large public urban plaza. Variance for height and parking.

Council approved variances:
•	increase the maximum building height of Building A from 45m to 55m
•	increase the maximum building height of Building B from 45m to 72m
•	increase the maximum building height of Building C from 45m to 65m
•	reduce the minimum setback for a rooftop structure from the outer edge of a roof from 3m to 0m for Building B
•	increase the maximum coverage for rooftop structures from 20% to 50%
•	reduce the required number of residential parking spaces from 297 to 226
•	reduce the required number of visitor parking spaces from 45 to 30.
This application was changed to DPV00205

SEE CONCURRENT REZONING APPLICATION REZ00883 FOR PROJECT DETAILS.

The City is considering a Development Permit with Variances application to allow for form and character changes to a previously approved proposal,which includes three distinct buildings over a shared commercial podium that includes office, a full-service grocery store, childcare and a large public urban plaza. Additional variances from the Council approved proposal relate to height and parking.

APPROVED BY COUNCIL July 31, 2025

Approved by Council November 16, 2023

The City is considering a Rezoning application to increase the density and construct three residential towers ranging in heights from 16 to 21 storeys over a shared commercial podium, including a large public plaza.

Concurrent with Development Permit with Variance No. 00205

Approved by Council November 16, 2023

Concurrent with Rezoning Application REZ00815

The City is considering a Development Permit with Variance application to develop three distinct buildings over a shared commercial podium that includes office, a full-service grocery store, childcare and a large public urban plaza. Variance for height and parking.

Council approved variances:
•	increase the maximum building height of Building A from 45m to 55m
•	increase the maximum building height of Building B from 45m to 72m
•	increase the maximum building height of Building C from 45m to 65m
•	reduce the minimum setback for a rooftop structure from the outer edge of a roof from 3m to 0m for Building B
•	increase the maximum coverage for rooftop structures from 20% to 50%
•	reduce the required number of residential parking spaces from 297 to 226
•	reduce the required number of visitor parking spaces from 45 to 30.
This application was changed to DPV00205
